tweets.text:
USBP agents, working with multiple agencies, shut down an illegal horse smuggling operation after spotting four riders crossing the border at an unauthorized location with multiple horses. Agents seized the horses, which are now pending veterinary clearance. All four individuals face prosecution for smuggling (18 USC 545) and illegal entry (19 USC 1459).

USBP does more than enforce immigration laws, we combat illegal trade and smuggling to protect lawful trade and commerce.

tweets.text:
This weekend, agents rescued 12 illegal aliens in two separate human smuggling cases. In Del Rio, TX, agents found six Guatemalan nationals - two locked in a toolbox and four hidden under a tarp in a truck bed. In Arizona, agents discovered six Mexican citizens, including an unaccompanied child, locked inside three tool compartments of a work truck. Agents arrested two smugglers, who now face prosecution for human smuggling (8 USC 1324).

Our agents remain relentless in stopping these dangerous smuggling attempts. #EndHumanSmuggling
